description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/entraining_plume_lev: the entraining-plume op replaced by one recurrence faq over lev (seed guard at k = 1, scalar trapezoidal stencil applied at every other cell). Every binding loads problems/plume_column_trapezoidal.esm (this case's fixture points at the runtime driver itself, as tests/conformance/ast/two_cartesian_grids_coexist does, so the exact document that simulates is the one whose lowering is byte-pinned and there is no second copy of its model to drift), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
